data.name: idx_sync_queue_pending

data.name: idx_sync_queue_failed

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "budget_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_id" TEXT NULL, "record_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "emoji" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'package', "color" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#2196F3', "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "category_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OUT', "usage_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "user_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_recurring" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurring_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parsing_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger_words" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "date_pattern" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "source_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "date_order" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'dmy' CHECK("date_order" IN ('dmy', 'mdy')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "message_sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_monitored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_monitored" IN (0, 1)), "auto_create_option" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expense_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES message_sources (id), "sample_message" TEXT NOT NULL, "trigger_word" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_pattern" TEXT NOT NULL, "description_pattern" TEXT NULL, "date_pattern" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "selected_amount" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budgets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "period" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rollover_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("rollover_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "rollover_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "user_id" INTEGER NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" REAL NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "next_occurrence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "auto_create_expense" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_create_expense" IN (0, 1)), "day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "uid" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "photo_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "last_login_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_queue" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "synced_at" INTEGER NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "failed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_amount" REAL NOT NULL, "saved_amount" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "monthly_contribution" REAL NULL, "user_id" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_records_date ON records (date)
CREATE INDEX idx_records_budget_id ON records (budget_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_records_user_id ON records (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_records_type_date ON records (record_type, date)
CREATE INDEX idx_records_category_date ON records (category_id, date)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_records_source_unique ON records (source_id, source) WHERE source_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_categories_user_id ON categories (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_recurring_req_id ON pending_recurring (recurring_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pending_recurring_cat_id ON pending_recurring (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_parsing_rules_cat_id ON parsing_rules (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_expense_templates_source_id ON expense_templates (source_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_expense_templates_cat_id ON expense_templates (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_budgets_user_id ON budgets (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_recurring_transactions_cat_id ON recurring_transactions (category_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_queue_pending ON sync_queue (created_at) WHERE synced_at IS NULL AND failed_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_queue_failed ON sync_queue (created_at) WHERE failed_at IS NOT NULL AND synced_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_queue_record ON sync_queue (entity_table, record_id, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_goals_user_id ON goals (user_id)
